verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party rendering documentation. Community reports do attest to a high-end real-time renderer: realistic real-time demos, 'beautiful lighting', looking better than Unity, and software ray-traced lighting that performs well even on a GTX 1060 without RT hardware. Missing for 10: first-party docs on PBR materials, global illumination or baked lighting, shadows and post-processing; explicit evidence for PBR, shadows and post-processing at all.
